KKR Income Opportunities Fund (KIO) 회장 겸 이사 Rudy Pimentel은 총 4,000주의 보통주에 해당하는 4건의 매수를 보고했다. 10월 1일 1,000주를 $10.30에 매수했으며, 10월 5일에는 각각 $10.24와 $10.20에 1,000주씩, 그리고 2026년 10월 8일에 $10.15에 1,000주를 매수했다. Rule 10b5-1 계획은 보고되지 않았다.

Holdings After Transaction: Common Stock — 15,154 shares (Direct)

F1. Includes shares of common stock acquired through the Issuer's automated Dividend Reinvestment Plan (DRIP).

A dividend reinvestment plan (DRIP) is a program that automatically uses the cash dividends an investor receives to buy additional shares (or fractions of shares) of the same company instead of paying out cash. Like a snowball that quietly grows larger, it helps investors compound returns over time, increase ownership without manual trades or commission costs, and change future income streams — though dividends used are still taxable as income.

How many KIO shares did Rudy Pimentel buy, and at what prices?

Rudy Pimentel, KIO's President and a director, reported four purchases of 1,000 common shares each: at $10.30 on October 1, at $10.24 and $10.20 on October 5, and at $10.15 on October 8, 2026. The October 1 transaction included shares acquired through the fund's automated Dividend Reinvestment Plan; no Rule 10b5-1 plan is reported.
